notes: Built-in emulator (Windows): Game Boy, Color, and Advance games — Red through Emerald — now open and play right inside PokeTracker, no external app. Includes sound with a volume control, hardware controller support, fully remappable keyboard AND gamepad controls (fast-forward is bindable too), selectable fast-forward speeds (2x-16x), fullscreen, and battery saves written right next to your ROM. Save sync upgraded: it now shows your Trainer name, Trainer ID and hidden Secret ID, and caught/total, then auto-fills your Pokedex. Android is unchanged (still uses external emulators).
